query: I am a 52-year-old male with type 2 diabetes. My BP is consistently 145/92 mmHg on Lisinopril 10mg. What does the guideline recommend for my blood pressure goal?

actual_citations.title: Hypertension in adults: diagnosis and management (NICE guideline NG136)
Hypertension in adults: diagnosis and management (NICE guideline NG136)

response_text: The guidelines recommend a blood pressure target of below 130/80 mmHg for people with type 2 diabetes [1]. Since you are already on Lisinopril 10mg and your blood pressure is consistently 145/92 mmHg, it may be necessary to discuss with your doctor whether additional treatment is needed to help you reach this target. The guidelines also support the use of an ACE inhibitor or ARB as first-line treatment for people with type 2 diabetes [2].
